name: lazaretto-plugins
description: Plugins from Lazaretto, a per-call supply-chain scanner for agents. Currently one: an install-path check against published malicious-package advisories.

plugins.name: lazaretto-guard
plugins.description: Before an install runs, check the pinned package versions in the command against published malicious-package advisories, and ask rather than block on a match. The same check runs on the package behind `claude mcp add`, `npx`, and an MCP server written into .mcp.json, where no advisory lookup happens today. Sends package names and versions and nothing else.
